en: I can mix you up a drink, any you want.
Well then I want a 1943 pinot noir in a bowler hat with a kiss on top.
I don't even know what that is and I know we don't have a bowler hat, either.
Then a #drink#, please.
Coming right up.
Pardon, bartender.
Yes, what did you need?
Did you get any training for this?
Well, no. Martin showed me how to d-gack!
(The drink was poured over my chest!)
Obviously not.
Oh, crap. That mistake's coming out of my pay and now I'm wet to boot.
Heyy, I got paid today!
Good for you!
Let's have a drink to payday!
Well...
Have a toast.
Turn it down.
Here's a salute to getting paid!
Woooooo!
Thanks for the drink! Heehee!
Thanks, but I need a clear head to work.
Awwww.
Can I ge-
Get me coffee!
Not you again!
Ugh, you don't have coffee do you? Get me #drink#, then!
(I'm surprised he's still alive!)
Hit me up with some #drink#, please.
Not a problem.
Damn, Martin when did you grow some tits?
I'm not Martin. And maybe I should cut you off.
I'll behave. Maybe.
Ugh. Whatever.
I've got the drinks you love.
And a whole lot more! Wowawow!
Your drink of choice today?
Gimme that #drink# goodness!
Yeah, I can do that.
What more can I do for you?
I see that Ionian whiskey. A shot would be appreciated.
Coming right up, sir!
(Okay, now to dig for that stuff... it's behind a few other of the more expensive-looking bottles... got it.)
Here we are. You said you wanted a shot?
Oh, yeah. That's the stuff. Here's a little extra.
Thanks.
(The barfly drank a sip of the drink and then a large one.)
Looks like a job well do-
(He spit it out onto me and swung the glass, drenching me!)
Hey! Guess I messed up the drink..
Ugh, now I'll be wet the rest of the shift.
You forgot my kiss, lady!
(Did I get the drink wrong? He has it pretty close to him.)
Check the drink.
Don't bother.
I lean over to check the drink-and he leans in and gives me a peck!
Yer a nice lady!
Oh my!
Nice. I really should have seen that coming.
The candy's in there, so have a good drink with that!
Here's your drink.
Can I get an extra kiss?
(Uhhh... not sure if I'm supposed to.)
Get another candy.
Don't bother
Here you g-mmph!
(He kissed me!)
There you go!
Woof! That's some bad breath! Looks like you'll need the extra kiss, haha!
Not unless you pay for it.
Aww.
There's something in my drink.
(Did I mess up?)
Look close.
Don't bother.
Let's see...
(I leaned in to look, and he kissed me instead!)
You should go with me outside to have a little fun!
Sorry! I'm a badge girl, can't just do that! But that was very fun!
Aww. At least I won the bet!
They're doing bets now?
I can see that it's exactly what you ordered. Go back to your table and I will serve you something later.
Aww, I lost the bet. Oh well, I'll go shell out some fuckbucks to my buddy.
Heeey, bartender!
What do you need?
Drink a shot with me!
(Should I?)
<color=perversion>Share a drink.</color>
Decline.
Cheers!
Toast!
I'm sure there's gonna be noooo consequences there, hehe!
Better not. Enjoy your drink.
Here's your drink!
Hey lady, I dare you to flash me the goodies!
Of course you are...
Come ooonnnn, do it for a laugh!
(What's the harm? Should I do it?)
<color=perversion>Flash your tits.</color>
Decline.
Oh, what the hell.
<color=Perversion>Enjoying the view?</color>
Yes ma'am!
At least you're polite!
Okay, show's over. Enjoy your drink.
Thanks!
Yeah, no thanks.
Nice try, but the only one I want to see my goodies is Karen.
Mm. Did you bartend before you showed up here? This is flawless.
Does that mean I'm hired? And no, not really. I just followed your recipe.
Yeah, you're hired. I'd be a fool not to.
You're sure you won't be sticking around?
I'm sure. There's something gone horribly wrong and I just can't stick around here when I can do something about it.
You're a decent sort. I'm glad I met you. Maybe the world's not so screwed after all.
Check with me when you want to work and I can take a break.
(Should I ask to work now...?)
Ask for work
Don't ask for work
Can I start now?
Sure thing, I'll go take a break.
Thanks a lot for this. I will see you when I'm ready to work!
Hmm... Alright, I've got a uniform in the back. I'll need <color=money>50 fuckbucks</color> to have it resized to fit you snug. Is that alright?
<color=money>(50fB)</color> Pay for uniform.
Cancel.
Martin told me that you could get me a uniform for working here. Do you have one I could use?
Yeah I do, here you can have it!
Perfect! Thank you!
Here ya go!
Perfect. I'll send Amber out to get the uniform done. Just wait here for a bit. We'll get started once we've got your new uniform.
Got the uniform here, Martin!
Wonderful! Now Jenna, I think you should know what you're getting into.
Like this is hard? I take orders and walk them to the table.
And I make sure not to spill while I get it to the right customers!
It sounds easier than it is. One of my old waitresses walked out to be a dump.
You might get groped, you'll get oogled and there's horny men who will pay you to do stuff women generally wouldn't before all this.
I hadn't thought about that, man the future's weird.
Here's how it'll work. You can work for me as a bartender during the day. That's safer for girls not looking to get harassed.
They'll give you their orders and you'll mix their drinks. There's recipes I wrote down using what we got for special drinks.
Do it well, I'll pay you and treat you right. Get it wrong and you'll get the amount you wasted taken off.
I won't let you down.
If you need extra money, you can work in the afternoon once the city hall's closed.
I don't recommend it if you're protecting your chastity, but it pays better than the bartending.
Good to know, <color=perversion>that evening job sounds like it wouldn't be so bad...</color>
(I might want to avoid the later shift for my own sanity!)
Let's run through making the drinks. You've already done a little waitressing, so I don't think I have to explain any more of that.
You're a smart girl. So let's get you back here and run through a little training.
There's a lot of bottles back here for being limited in supplies.
This is nothing. The selection before all this was a lot better. Higher quality, some of it.
You did this before this dump?
Yeah, long story. I worked my ass off in a lot of places. I might tell you about it another day.
Okay. How do I do this?
The recipe book's got all the mixes. Sometimes a guy might just ask for a specific flavor or on the rocks.
On the rocks is with ice. They might also ask for a kiss.
A kiss?!
Yeah, one of the cherry candies since we don't have the real deal.
Got it! Think I'm ready!
Okay. Let's test that. Make two drinks. Let's start with making #drink#. Take your time, I'm not impatient but some other men are.
(Alright, let's look at the recipe book and supplies.)
Hi there, would you happen to have an opening for a waitress? I'm very careful!
Not right now, the badge girl you were lookin' for has taken care of what customers I got for today. Come back later?
That wasn't Karen, though. I didn't know her. Thanks anyway.
Sometimes you don't get what you want, lady.
I'm not looking for a waitress right now. The one working for me at the moment might not stay for much longer though. So maybe you should come back tomorrow.
Yeah, that won't work. I could have you work as a waitress in the evening, but I don't think you're satisfied either.
Rude!
This might be the only bar in town, but I know you can do better. You can do it. Take your time.
Let's try this again. Can you make #drink# for me?
You have to pay attention, Jenna. Some of the men in here won't be patient and they'll demand their money back.
Whoops! I guess I can do that again.
You can. Let's try again with #drink#.
That's pretty good. Better than I expected, actually.
Awesome! So you'll have me work since I blew you away?
Haha, I wouldn't go so far. You've not done this before and that's clear but you filled my order well for all that. That's about what those guys expect so good enough.
Oh. Well, this won't be forever. I just need to do what I can to get back to Karen.
I understand. You're hired. Check with me when you want to work and we'll get you set up and earning.
Unless you wanna start now.
Hmm...
Ask for work
Don't ask for work
Go ahead and go take a break.
I'll come back to check on you later when you're done.
Time to start changing days!
Maybe another time, Martin. Thanks.
Let me know if you change your mind later.
Alright Jenna, that should be it for today. Good job, here's your pay.
Thanks!
Oh and don't forget to come back tomorrow if you are interested in more work.
This is shit. Make another one!
Whoops. That's coming out of my pay.
Do you have room for me to bartend today?
Sure thing, Jenna. I'll go on my break.
Just in time. Come on back so I can go take care of something with Jewel.
Well, you guys have fun. <color=Perversion>Wish that I could join you...</color> Woah, girl. Time to work.
Hey, Martin. I'll be taking a shift today. That okay?
Yeah, that's nice timing for me. Come on back.
Here's your order!
About time.
Here you are!
I go to place his order on the table, realizing a little too late that my skirt is too short to properly hide everything while I'm leaning over.
H-Hey!
Whoops, sorry. My hand just fell.
Sure, buddy.
So you do want to work as a waitress in the later hours?
How bad can it be?

Simply bring the orders to the tables and come back to me. The tables all have their own number from 1 to 6. You don't need to take new orders from customers, they order via the displays in our menus.
Fancy!
Oh well, it's certainly outdated tech, but it works.
Let's get going then. Bring this order to table #TableNum#.
I won't disappoint you!
Here you go!
I place the order on the table, being careful not to drop anything.
One of the customers suddenly brushes by me and grabs my boobs.
You guys just can't keep your hands to yourselves now can you?
Can't resis' youu in tha outfit, hahaha..
(I guess Martin did warn me.)
You weren't lying when you said that the late shift is something else. Getting groped is part of the deal here, isn't it? What do we do to stop that?
There's not much we can do... I have to give the people more reason to come than bad food and alcohol. Sorry, Jenna...
So you're asking me to just endure it?
That's how business is right now. Please stay and help me.
Fine... But only because you were nice to me so far.
Thank you, Jenna. Now please bring this to table #TableNum#.
Alright.
Here's your order!
As I lean over to place the plate on the table, I feel a sharp pain on my ass.
(Stay cool, Jenna. It's just how this bar works.)
The customer places his hand on my skirt, groping my ass while I lean over to place the plate in front of him.
I'm trying to do my work here!
Pah, what am I paying for, if not this?
I'm grinding my teeth, letting him grope me.
(I have to let him or Martin will get in trouble...)
Very nice... I might come here more often with you around, sweetass.
He chuckles before finally letting go of me.
I'm done with that one. Give me the next order so I can get through this quickly.
You're doing great so far Jenna. Just one more order and you should be done for the night!
Ugh, I hope so.
Here, just bring this to table #TableNum# and I'll take care of the rest for today.
On it...
Here's your order!
Without hesitating, a guest takes hold of my boobs with both hands.
Love the milk service, haha!
Enjoy your Drinks...
I will, but it won't beat squeezing your nice tits.
(Asshole.)
Glad you decided to help out for another evening. The customers really liked you last time.
I bet they did...
Great! Can you bring this order to table #TableNum# please?
On it, Martin.
(Should I really earn money doing... this? Being the eye candy attraction for a bunch of drunken horny guys...?)
